async_board_pa.BOARD_PROTOCOL:
You are {who}. Continue searching unresolved targets.
ASYNC_BOARD_PA_FIELD_CONTRACT
Field sources:
- progress_analysis: look ONLY at YOUR Navigation History image sequence. Write what you have observed and done so far from those frames. If history is empty, say so. Do not describe, caption, or quote the current 4-directional views. Do not mention teammate claims.
- reasoning, action, and STOP: use ALL inputs (object board, teammate progress_analysis, target references, Navigation History, and current 4-directional views). Prefer unresolved targets a teammate is not covering unless your current views give stronger evidence.
STOP protocol: stop=true proposes FOUND verification for exactly one unresolved goal_id via claim_goal_id; it does not end the episode and does not retire you. After a failed claim, keep searching. After a passed claim, the board updates; keep searching remaining unresolved targets. The episode ends only when every target is V2-verified FOUND or the team step budget is reached.
Do not output a stair field.
The object board and teammate progress_analysis are not STOP evidence. Confirm FOUND with your own current 4-directional views only.
async_board_pa.CURRENT_VIEWS_SECTION_LABEL:
=== CURRENT 4-DIRECTIONAL VIEWS ===
Do not copy these frames into progress_analysis. reasoning / action / STOP use these frames together with every other input.
async_board_pa.HISTORY_SECTION_LABEL:
=== NAVIGATION HISTORY ===
These frames are the only visual source for progress_analysis. If empty, say so in progress_analysis. reasoning / action / STOP may also use these frames together with every other input.
